finding.frozen_assumption: fmr_template_t.optional_state_layout_id could be interpreted as a global 0/1 temporal-history enum
finding.meaning: The existing optional_state_layout_id already identifies feature/physical optional-state layouts such as snow and is not a F-KT numerical-continuation enum.

architectural_correction.reason: Keep physical optional state distinct from numerical continuation state and allow both to coexist in one model template.

rejected_corrections: Reserve magic ranges inside optional_state_layout_id and overload its meaning.
Treat every nonzero optional_state_layout_id as temporal history.
Disable existing snow optional-state scaling to make the frozen 0/1 assumption pass.
